arxiv-1907-03597.title: Conformal image of an osculating curve on a smooth immersed surface
arxiv-1907-03597.creator: Absos Ali Shaikh 1 , Mohamd Saleem Lone 2 and Pinaki Ranjan Ghosh 3
arxiv-1907-03597.description: Abstract . The main intention of the paper is to investigate an osculating curve under the conformal map. We obtain a sufficient condition for the conformal invariance of an osculating curve. We also find an equivalent system of a geodesic curve under the conformal transformation(motion) and show its invariance under isometry and homothetic motion.

arxiv-2208-12640.creator: Soheyl Massoudi, Jürg Schiffmann
arxiv-2208-12640.description: Abstract The purpose of this study is to introduce ANN-based software for the fast evaluation of rotordynamics in the context of robust and integrated design. It is based on a surrogate model made of ensembles of artificial neural networks running in a Bokeh web application.

arxiv-2210-02817.title: The reducible double confluent Heun equation and a general symmetric unfolding of the origin
arxiv-2210-02817.creator: Tsvetana Stoyanova
arxiv-2210-02817.description: Abstract Department of Mathematics and Informatics, Sofia University, 5 J. Bourchier Blvd., Sofia 1164, Bulgaria, cveti@fmi.uni-sofia.bg Abstract. The reducible double confluent Heun equation (DCHE) is the only DCHE whose general symmetric unfolding leads to a Fuchsian equation. Contrary to the general Heun equation the unfolded Fuchsian equation has 5 singular points: x_{L}=-\sqrt{\varepsilon},x_{R}=\sqrt{\varepsilon},x_{LL}=-1/\sqrt{\varepsilon},x_{RR}=1/\sqrt{\varepsilon} and x_{\infty}=\infty .

arxiv-2302-14234.title: Bicriteria Multidimensional Mechanism Design with Side Information
arxiv-2302-14234.creator: Maria-Florina Balcan, Siddharth Prasad, Tuomas Sandholm
arxiv-2302-14234.description: Abstract We develop a versatile methodology for multidimensional mechanism design that incorporates side information about agents to generate high welfare and high revenue simultaneously. Side information sources include advice from domain experts, predictions from machine learning models, and even the mechanism designer’s gut instinct.

arxiv-2410-06554.title: The Accuracy Paradox in RLHF: When Better Reward Models Don’t Yield Better Language Models
arxiv-2410-06554.creator: Yanjun Chen, Dawei Zhu, Yirong Sun, Xinghao Chen, Wei Zhang, Xiaoyu Shen
arxiv-2410-06554.description: Abstract Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback significantly enhances Natural Language Processing by aligning language models with human expectations. A critical factor in this alignment is the strength of reward models used during training. This study explores whether stronger reward models invariably lead to better language models.

arxiv-2503-16309.title: Rapid patient-specific neural networks for intraoperative X-ray to volume registration
arxiv-2503-16309.creator: Vivek Gopalakrishnan †, David-Dimitris Chlorogiannis, Andrew Abumoussa, Anna M. Larson, Nazim Haouchine, Darren B. Orbach, Sarah Frisken, Neel Dey †, Polina Golland †
arxiv-2503-16309.description: Abstract \lx@add@cssclass{ltx_runin}\theabstract Abstract Advanced navigation techniques in image-guided interventions and surgical robotics require the rapid and precise alignment of 3D preoperative volumes ( e.g ., CT, MRI) to 2D intraoperative images ( e.g ., X-ray fluoroscopy) [ 1 , 2 ] .

arxiv-2509-04731.title: Hierarchical Task Environments as the Next Frontier for Embodied World Models in Robot Soccer
arxiv-2509-04731.creator: Brennen Hill
arxiv-2509-04731.description: Abstract Recent advances in agent development have focused on scaling model size and raw interaction data, mirroring the successes seen in large language models. However, for complex, long-horizon multi-agent tasks such as robotic soccer, this end-to-end approach often fails due to intractable exploration spaces and sparse rewards.

arxiv-2509-22609.title: Overview of the ESCAPE Dark Matter Test Science Project for Astronomers
arxiv-2509-22609.creator: James Pearson 1, Hugh Dickinson 1, Sukanya Sinha 2, and Stephen Serjeant 1
arxiv-2509-22609.description: Abstract The search for dark matter has been ongoing for decades within both astrophysics and particle physics. Both fields have employed different approaches and conceived a variety of methods for constraining the properties of dark matter, but have done so in relative isolation of one another.

arxiv-2601-11231.title: Adaptive Monitoring of Stochastic Fire Front Processes via Information-seeking Predictive Control
arxiv-2601-11231.creator: Savvas Papaioannou, Panayiotis Kolios, Christos G. Panayiotou and Marios M. Polycarpou
arxiv-2601-11231.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Savvas Papaioannou, Panayiotis Kolios, Christos G. Panayiotou and Marios M. Polycarpou. We consider the problem of adaptively monitoring a wildfire front using a mobile agent (e.g., a drone), whose trajectory determines where sensor data is collected and thus influences the accuracy of fire propagation estimation. This is a challenging problem, as the stochastic nature of wildfire evolution requires the seamless integration of sensing, estimation, and control, often treated separately in existing methods.

pmc-10699304.creator: Jing Qin, Caiqin Zhang, Yong Zhao, Dengxu Tan, Pengpeng Wu, Xue Shui, Weijun Qin, Xu Ge, Changhong Shi
pmc-10699304.description: Prostate cancer (PCa) is considered to be the most prevalent malignancy in males worldwide. Abiraterone is a 17α-hydroxylase/C17, 20-lyase (CYP17) inhibitor that has been approved for use in patients with prostate cancer. However, several negative aspects, such as drug resistance, toxicity, and lack of real-time monitoring of treatment responses, could appear with long-term use.

pmc-11772495.creator: Francesca Di Filippo, Tiziana A. L. Brevini, Georgia Pennarossa, Fulvio Gandolfi
pmc-11772495.description: Accelerating the genetic selection to obtain animals more resilient to climate changes, and with a lower environmental impact, would greatly benefit by a substantial shortening of the generation interval. One way to achieve this goal is to generate male gametes directly from embryos.

pmc-12473964.title: Duckweed’s Effects on Rice Yield and Quality Varied with Fertilizer Applications
pmc-12473964.creator: Yipeng Zhao, Guizhi Shi, Jingsheng Luo, Xinyong Zhao, Shaowu Hu, Tingting Hu, Lianxin Yang, Yunxia Wang, Sowjanya Sree Kandregula, Viktor Oláh, Klaus-Jürgen Appenroth, Fucang Zhang
pmc-12473964.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The incidence of duckweed (Lemna minor L.) outbreaks in paddy fields has increased in recent years, but how it impacts rice production is still under debate. This study assessed duckweed’s effects on rice yield and quality under different fertilizer regimes: organic fertilizer (OF), chemical fertilizer (CF), a mix (one-third OF and two-thirds CF based on nitrogen content, COF), and no fertilizer (NF) as a control. For each fertilizer regime, two duckweed treatments were applied: duckweed coverage (Duckweed) and no duckweed coverage (Control).

For this purpose, questionnaires were established.

pmc-12728190.creator: Weihao Zhang, Jiajie Lin, Yi Zhou, Changhua Wu, Qibo Li, Junhua Chen, Yipeng Zeng, Zipeng Xiao, Huiyong Shen, Yanfeng Wu, Zepeng Su, Wenhui Yu, Zhongyu Xie

However, these functions are strongly affected by the inflammatory microenvironment in vivo, which limits the therapeutic effect of MSCs. The present study demonstrated that TNF-α impairs the immunosuppressive effect of MSCs on T-cell proliferation.

pmc-13202512.creator: Massimo Magrini, Olivia Curzio, Cristina Dolciotti, Gabriele Donzelli, Maria Cristina Imiotti, Fabrizio Minichilli, Davide Moroni, Paolo Bongioanni, Tiffany Leung
pmc-13202512.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundExtended reality (XR), encompassing virtual reality, augmented reality (AR), and mixed reality, is increasingly being used in neurorehabilitation to provide multisensory feedback and promote neural plasticity in sensorimotor networks.ObjectiveThis scoping review aimed to (1) examine how XR technologies are applied in motor neurorehabilitation, (2) explore how body representation and somatic embodiment are addressed, and (3) analyze the methodological designs of XR-based interventions.MethodsThis review was conducted in accordance with the PRISMA-ScR (Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses extension for Scoping Reviews)

pmc-13607722.creator: Haitao Li, Zhen Wang, Xin Liu, Xiao Sun
pmc-13607722.description: Genome-wide association studies (GWASs) have identified numerous loci associated with Alzheimer’s disease (AD), yet the effector genes and regulatory mechanisms underlying many of these associations remain unresolved. This challenge is particularly pronounced for non-coding variants, whose regulatory effects may extend over long genomic distances and cannot be reliably inferred from the nearest gene alone.

pmc-13627038.title: Early use of levosimendan to improve survival and neurological outcomes after cardiac arrest with myocardial dysfunction: a protocol for a randomized controlled trial
pmc-13627038.creator: Zhen De, Nengyuan Xu, Hua Zhang, Fan Yang, Lanfang Du
pmc-13627038.description: IntroductionPost-cardiac arrest myocardial dysfunction (PAMD) is a major contributor to early death (within 72 hours) following return of spontaneous circulation (ROSC). Levosimendan, a calcium-sensitizing inotrope with vasodilatory and mitochondrial-protective properties, offers a potential therapeutic strategy by increasing cardiac output, improving organ perfusion, and attenuating mitochondrial ischemia-reperfusion injury.

Intra-abdominal gossypiboma frequently occurs after cholecystectomy.

uslaw-usc-t2-s6112.title: 2 U.S.C. § 6112 — Compensation of Deputy President pro tempore of Senate
uslaw-usc-t2-s6112.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t2-s6112.description: United States Code, Title 2 (The Congress); Chapter 61 (Senate Leadership); Subchapter II (Vice President And President Pro Tempore). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Effective January 5, 1977, the compensation of a Deputy President pro tempore of the Senate shall be at a rate equal to the rate of annual compensation of the President pro tempore and the Majority and Minority Leaders.

uslaw-usc-t6-s972.title: 6 U.S.C. § 972 — Additional personnel
uslaw-usc-t6-s972.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t6-s972.description: United States Code, Title 6 (Domestic Security); Chapter 3 (Security And Accountability For Every Port); Subchapter II (Security Of The International Supply Chain); Part B (Customs–Trade Partnership Against Terrorism). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. For fiscal years 2008 and 2009, the Commissioner shall increase by not less than 50 the number of full-time personnel engaged in the validation and revalidation of C–TPAT.
